notes.subject: ol man bilong sanguma
notes.rationale: מכשפים em ol man i wokim pawa nogut; 'sanguma' em tok bilong pawa nogut long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: witnes i stret swift
notes.rationale: עד ממהר: 'swift witness' o 'witness making haste' — tupela i wankain kwik

notes.subject: long yupela
notes.rationale: Yahwe i tok stret long ol man bilong Yisrael

translation: Na bai mi kam klostu long yupela bilong kot, na bai mi kamap olsem witnes i stret swift long ol man bilong sanguma, na long ol man i slip wantaim meri bilong narapela man, na long ol man i sutim tok long sampela nogut, na long ol i skruisim pe bilong wokman, long widow, long pikinini i no gat papa, na long ol i save torsim man i stap long ples bilong narapela — na ol i no pret long mi, Yahwe Tsebaot i tok.
